properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 14 at 2:41PM PST until November 15 at 10:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 5 to
7 feet with sets 8 to 10 feet along west-facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest surf is expected to occur now
through early Sunday. Surf begins to subside Sunday afternoon
but will remain elevated into Monday.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 14 at 12:51PM PST until November 15 at 1:00AM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Del Norte Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 1 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Wind gusts will be particularly strong along windward
ridges and exposed coastal headlands. Gusty winds will blow around
unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power
outages may result.

properties.areaDesc: San Francisco; Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National Seashore; San Francisco Peninsula Coast; Northern Monterey Bay; Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 14 at 1:05AM PST until November 14 at 6:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Warning, dangerously large breaking
waves of 25 to 35 ft, with occasional sets of 40 to 50 ft at
favored breakpoints. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, large
breaking waves will run up beaches and crash over seawalls,
inundating adjacent, low-lying infrastructure.

* WHERE...All Pacific Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Warning, until 4 AM PST Sunday. For the
Coastal Flood Advisory, now through 6 PM PST today.

* IMPACTS...High tides will result in flooding of low-lying
infrastructure, isolated road closures, and coastal erosion.
Rising tides will bring water and waves farther up the beach
than normal, restricting escape from beaches and coastal
areas. Dangerously large breaking waves can overpower
swimmers, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks resulting in significant physical injury and
increasing the risk of drowning. Waves can sweep across the
shoreline without warning, pulling people into the sea from
beaches, jetties, and rocks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The Coastal Flood Advisory today is
specifically for the Pacific Coast, where large breaking waves
will spill over sea walls and run up beaches onto adjacent
infrastructure.

properties.areaDesc: Point Piedras Blancas to Point Sal westward out to 10 NM
properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 14 at 2:32PM PST until November 18 at 3:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...Point Piedras Blancas to Point Sal westward out to 10
NM.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
